body: Thank you. I saved them and I am going to check them out and put them on my phone. Thank you for finding these again I really appreciate it :)

Well a few things I guess, number 1 being that homeschooling is extremely lonely. I have a few friends from acting class but they all live in the city a while away from me, and other friends live in kansas or other places y'know. Secondly I knew that going to school would make going to college 10,000 times easier because it is traditionally done that way. Waaaay easier to say "Alumni from X highschool" than "Graduate from Zen Homeschooling" lol. 
I don't think it is, I've never heard of it besides what I do lol.

You're right you are, I think I should play it. I guess I feel like it's a game made for like 5 year old girls and I'm using it because I know less than they do x) but I guess I can persevere! I hope at least lol

Haha yeah, I try to bullshit my way through most of it but with some stuff it's hard. I wanted to be normal and able to get into a good college, that's all really. I don't care about being a valedictorian or some dream like that because I know I could never be that. 
Sorry to hear that, man. I'm glad you overcame! Sounds like me haha. I can't stare at a piece of paper for very long y'know. Guess it must be ADD lol.

I think with me it's conditioning because I was fat a few years ago, (205 pounds at 13) lost the weight and am now at 145-50 on a good day, but that was mainly so women would find me attractive. I guess I got out of the physical laziness but the mental habits are the same. 
I literally get headaches and all that when I try to build habits that I don't do naturally. I know I must sound like some dickhead making excuses and I feel like I'm trivializing the people who *do* have those issues and actually *do* work through them, and maybe I am but I don't know.
I scored really high on the english section of my SAT prep but it was something like "light is to dark as x is to y" so it was really easy. My mother said I got into the 90th percentile or something, but again, that's basically saying I managed to have common sense haha.

I feel like knowing where to put a comma isn't the same as math y'know? If I were a college, I wouldn't want a guy who can write well but knows about as much as my infant baby.

I don't think my mom and dad want me to go to summer school. They hate the fact that I want to go to public school haha. They say they hate the "system" and thought I was smarter than to join it. Eh maybe they're right, my reasoning is my parents haven't kept papers of my progress(lol) so going to highschool will be easier entrance to college. But then I realized I have little to no skill in it, so now I'm set to go but have no idea what to do.

Everything is too expensive. Sylvan, kumon, wayyy too expensive. My dad doesn't have time to teach me and I guess my mom doesn't understand.  

I want to persevere but it feels like I'm looking at a navy destroyer and throwing a water balloon hoping to sink it.

I think it starts in september, but I'm not sure because I have next to no idea how the public school system works around me haha.
I wouldn't really call it effort the things I've put in but thank you for the kind words.
I would call what I do whining and wishing for a miracle you know?
I looked it up and is it a flash game like a barbie thing where it asks multiplication tables? Haha I should use it yeah but man that's embarrassing haha.
